## Checklist

- [ ] The scope is linked to an issue or accepted RFC when required.
- [ ] Tests cover observable behavior and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] Public behavior and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when applicable.
- [ ] Formatting, Clippy, tests, and rustdoc pass locally.
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary and comply with `deny.toml`.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and commits contain no secrets or sensitive data.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.
